_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Labor Rate Performance Report
summary: The Labor Rate Performance Report gives the Government monthly average spend rate information compared to average bid rate averages to monitor contract labor rate performance.
use_relationship:
This information will be used by the Government to monitor monthly average spend rates compared to average bid rate averages.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figures 1 and 2.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all information specified in Figures 1 and 2 and shall also include the following:

children.title: Incurred cost to the contract line item number
children.content: Incurred cost to the contract line item number (CLIN funding source) level, by base and option year, as applicable and shall include the following:

children.title: Contract Values and subsequent delta
children.content: Contract Values and subsequent delta between expenditures and contract values, by elements identified in alpha a.

children.title: Funding remaining to be invoiced
children.content: Funding remaining to be invoiced separated by elements identified in item 2.a.

children.title: Ceiling remaining to be invoiced
children.content: Ceiling remaining to be invoiced separated by elements identified in item 2.a.

children.title: Contract rates, funded rates and spend rates
children.content: Contract rates, funded rates and spend rates, identified by Fully Burdened Cost (FBC), FCC and Total.
